docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FILED BY LEE, YIN RUI T. AS TO DEFENDANT AMERICA BUILDING SERVICE, INC. ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR OCT-16-2009 AT 03:30 PM IN DEPT 506
SERVICE OF COMPLAINT BY CERTIFIED MAIL FILED BY PLAINTIFF LEE, YIN RUI T. AS TO DEFENDANT AMERICA BUILDING SERVICE, INC.
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED SEP-08-2009, COURT CERTIFIED MAIL RETURNED SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT AMERICA BUILDING SERVICE, INC.

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF OCT-16-2009 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF OCT-16-2009 BY JUDGE PRO TEM: DAVID MCDONALD. APPEARANCE BY BOTH PARTIES. EXHIBITS RETAINED. MEI LI INTERPRETS ENGLISG/TOISHANESE - TOISHANESE/ENGLISH ON THE PLAINTIFF'S BEHALF. CLERK: S. VANTREE. NOT REPORTED. (506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF OCT-16-2009 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF LEE, YIN RUI T. IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT AMERICA BUILDING SERVICE, INC. COURT FINDS THAT (1) THE DEFINITION OF "HOURS WORKED" DOES NOT INCLUDE VACATION AND SICK DAYS; (2) THE CONTRACT IS SUBJECT TO A MANDATORY GRIEVANCE AND BINDING ARBITRATION PROCEEDING WHICH WASN'T FOLLOWED BY THE PLAINTIFF IN THIS CASE. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
EXHIBITS FROM EXHIBIT REPORT DATED JAN-04-2010 ORDERED DESTROYED
